plugin.name: Mwp
plugin.description:
Mwp: Moment magnitude from P-wave displacement integral (Tsuboi et al. 1995, 1999). Measures the double integral of P-wave ground velocity on vertical BHZ channels at teleseismic distances (5–105 deg) and converts to Mw via M0.
The Mw(Mwp) estimate uses the linear Whitmore et al. (2002) correction. All regression coefficients and the amplitude measurement strategy are configurable from global.cfg so operators can apply updated calibrations without recompiling.

binding.name: Mwp
binding.description: Parameters for computing Mwp and the derived Mw(Mwp) estimate.

parameter.name: useFirstPeak
parameter.description:
If true, use the first local maximum of the doubly-integrated displacement after the P arrival (Tsuboi et al. 1995 original algorithm) instead of the global maximum in the signal window.
The global-maximum default was adopted in SeisComP for robustness on noisy records; the first-peak option is theoretically cleaner because later arrivals (PP, pP, surface reflections) can inflate the global maximum for large events, contributing to Mwp saturation.
Default false preserves backward compatibility with existing SeisComP Mwp measurements.

extend-struct.description: Depth-dependent Mw(Mwp) regression parameters calibrated against GCMT (2015–2026, M≥6.0, N=1197). Three depth classes are used because regression slopes differ systematically: shallow crustal events require a smaller correction than intermediate or deep events. Depth boundaries and all coefficients are configurable without recompiling.

group.name: estimateMw

parameter.name: shallowMaxDepth
parameter.description: Upper depth boundary (km) of the shallow class. Events with depth <= shallowMaxDepth use the shallow coefficients.

parameter.name: intermediateMaxDepth
parameter.description: Upper depth boundary (km) of the intermediate class. Events with depth > shallowMaxDepth and <= intermediateMaxDepth use the intermediate coefficients. Events deeper than this use the deep coefficients.

group.name: shallow
group.description: Coefficients for shallow events (0 – shallowMaxDepth km). Defaults calibrated from GCMT 2015–2026, N=1002, sigma=0.204.

parameter.name: a
parameter.description: Slope of Mw = a * Mwp + b for shallow events.

parameter.name: b
parameter.description: Intercept of Mw = a * Mwp + b for shallow events.

parameter.name: stdError
parameter.description: Standard error of the shallow Mw(Mwp) regression.

group.name: intermediate
group.description: Coefficients for intermediate-depth events (shallowMaxDepth – intermediateMaxDepth km). Defaults calibrated from GCMT 2015–2026, N=215, sigma=0.081.

parameter.name: a
parameter.description: Slope of Mw = a * Mwp + b for intermediate events.

parameter.name: b
parameter.description: Intercept of Mw = a * Mwp + b for intermediate events.

parameter.name: stdError
parameter.description: Standard error of the intermediate Mw(Mwp) regression.

group.name: deep
group.description: Coefficients for deep events (depth > intermediateMaxDepth km). Defaults calibrated from GCMT 2015–2026, N=114, sigma=0.112.

parameter.name: a
parameter.description: Slope of Mw = a * Mwp + b for deep events.

parameter.name: b
parameter.description: Intercept of Mw = a * Mwp + b for deep events.

parameter.name: stdError
parameter.description: Standard error of the deep Mw(Mwp) regression.
